title: How to Get the Best Price for Your South Tampa Home
topic: How to get the best price for your South Tampa home
gbp_post:
Most South Tampa sellers leave money on the table not because they priced wrong, but because they prepared wrong. Here is what the data actually shows.

Homes in South Tampa that sell above list price share a few measurable traits: they hit the market on a Thursday or Friday, they have professional photography posted before the first showing, and they are priced at or just below the psychological threshold for their tier. A home listed at $1,195,000 consistently outperforms one listed at $1,210,000 in days on market and final sale price as a percentage of list.

Condition is the variable sellers underestimate most. On Bayshore Boulevard, Davis Islands, and in Palma Ceia, buyers are comparing your home against three or four others in real time. A fresh coat of neutral paint, clean landscaping, and a deep clean before photos are taken are not cosmetic gestures. They are pricing tools. Deferred maintenance signals risk to buyers and their lenders, and buyers price that risk in — usually more aggressively than the actual repair cost.

Timing matters too. South Tampa inventory typically compresses in late winter and early spring. Sellers who list in February and March compete in the tightest supply environment of the year.

The homes that sell for the most are not always the most expensive to prepare.
